why_new_attempt_is_justified: DELL VS4 proved the shared candidate, capture and Evidence Role path but did not prove equivalent natural propositions for MU or NVDA
the current MU and NVDA Packs contain broad source segments and oversized pseudo-claims that hide usable exact current claims already present in the canonical object store

this attempt asks ten business propositions spanning downstream demand, issuer results, customer commitments, supply execution and counterevidence without changing the object snapshot or joining labels before scoring
not_changed: 33085-object canonical snapshot, current Case identities, research as-of, financial intent ontology and hard filters
BGE-M3 and Qwen embedding models, BGE and Qwen rerankers, candidate limits and Evidence authority boundaries
DELL VS4 result and all earlier attempts remain immutable
ORCL, ASML and ANET remain unavailable for tuning and reserved for later qualification design

bge_embedding.node_purpose: Encode the ten natural MU/NVDA proposition requests while reusing the immutable BGE-M3 object cache.
bge_embedding.input_scale: 33085 cached compiled objects plus retrieval needs from ten pre-registered atoms across MU and NVDA; no document re-encoding unless cache identity fails.
bge_embedding.schema_burden: numeric arrays, cache identity and hardware receipt only
bge_embedding.materiality_and_quality_risk: truncation can hide shipment, contract, capacity, customer-concentration or counterevidence qualifiers; 512 tokens covers each atomic need and exact claim surface.
bge_embedding.comparable_run_evidence: DELL VS4 encoded three natural propositions on the same immutable object cache and recovered every pre-registered positive into the candidate union.
bge_embedding.reasoning_profile: local retrieval encoder on CUDA FP16; no generative reasoning
bge_embedding.stop_and_truncation: maximum 512 tokens, batch 4, fail on CUDA, model, object or cache identity drift; no CPU or network fallback

qwen_embedding.node_purpose: Provide a provider-neutral semantic challenger for the same ten MU/NVDA propositions on the unchanged object snapshot.
qwen_embedding.input_scale: 33085 cached compiled objects plus retrieval needs from ten pre-registered atoms.
qwen_embedding.schema_burden: numeric arrays, cache identity and hardware receipt only
qwen_embedding.materiality_and_quality_risk: semantic similarity may confuse safe-harbor, contact, metric or cross-company text with usable financial Evidence; hard negatives and the Evidence Role gate remain independent.
qwen_embedding.comparable_run_evidence: DELL VS4 and VS3 showed Qwen can add candidate recall but cannot independently grant Evidence authority.
qwen_embedding.reasoning_profile: local retrieval encoder on CUDA FP16; no generative reasoning
qwen_embedding.stop_and_truncation: maximum 512 tokens, batch 8, fail on CUDA or identity drift; no CPU or network fallback

bge_reranker.node_purpose: Score the shared bounded candidate pools for ten business propositions without changing membership or Evidence authority.
bge_reranker.input_scale: at most 5120 query-candidate pairs across ten atoms before cache reuse.
bge_reranker.schema_burden: flat score vectors plus deterministic pair manifest
bge_reranker.materiality_and_quality_risk: a semantic reranker can promote wrong speaker, period or evidence role; explicit safe-harbor, contact and unrelated-financial hard negatives test this boundary.
bge_reranker.comparable_run_evidence: DELL VS4 proved transport and full hard-negative suppression under the same scorer, while retaining Evidence Role as a separate gate.
bge_reranker.stop_and_truncation: maximum 1024 tokens, batch 2, exact score-count match and CUDA required; no CPU fallback

qwen_reranker.node_purpose: Independently score the same ten candidate pools for direct answerability and financial relevance.
qwen_reranker.input_scale: at most 5120 query-candidate pairs across ten atoms before cache reuse.
qwen_reranker.schema_burden: flat score vectors plus deterministic pair manifest
qwen_reranker.materiality_and_quality_risk: instruction following must not override issuer, period, source, relationship direction or ecosystem attribution boundaries.
qwen_reranker.comparable_run_evidence: DELL VS4 showed Qwen head quality is useful as one signal but not sufficient for Evidence promotion.
qwen_reranker.stop_and_truncation: maximum 1024 tokens, batch 2, exact score-count match and CUDA required; no CPU fallback
